│  report.                                                                 │

│  stakeholders.                                                           │
│  - End of Month 2: Team formation complete, roles assigned, and          │
│  orientations scheduled.                                                 │

│  - Project management                                                    │
│  - Communication skills (oral and written)                               │
│  - Data analysis                                                         │
│  - Organizational skills                                                 │

│  **Objective:** Execute clean-up events and related activities as        │
│  planned.                                                                │
│                                                                          │
│  **Steps:**                                                              │

│     - Plan specific dates and times for clean-ups.                       │
│     - Order necessary supplies, such as gloves, garbage bags, and        │
│  recycling bins.                                                         │
│     - Coordinate transportation if volunteers will be shuttled to        │
│  multiple locations.                                                     │
│                                                                          │

│     - Send out invitations and reminders to the volunteer teams.         │
│     - Provide detailed instructions on what to expect during the event.  │
│                                                                          │
│  3. **Clean-Up Events (Monthly from Month 4 onwards)**                   │
│     - Conduct clean-ups as scheduled, ensuring proper waste disposal.    │
│     - Document the progress and impact of each cleanup through photos    │
│  or videos.                                                              │
│                                                                          │
│  **Milestones:**                                                         │
│  - End of Month 3: All necessary supplies ordered and volunteer          │
│  confirmations received.                                                 │
│  - Monthly by End of Month 6: Report on completed clean-up events with   │
│  detailed outcomes and successes.                                        │
│                                                                          │
│  **Skills Needed:**                                                      │
│  - Event management                                                      │
│  - Effective communication (verbal and written)                          │
│  - Team leadership                                                       │
│                                                                          │

│  **Objective:** Evaluate the effectiveness of the clean-ups and plan     │
│  for future expansion.                                                   │
│                                                                          │
│  **Steps:**                                                              │
│  1. **Evaluation Methods (Weeks 1-4)**                                   │
│     - Develop a survey to gather feedback from volunteers.               │
│     - Collect quantitative data on litter collected and areas improved.  │
│                                                                          │
│  2. **Feedback Analysis (Month 7)**                                      │
│     - Analyze the survey results and data collected.                     │
│     - Identify successful strategies and areas for improvement.          │
│                                                                          │
│  3. **Scaling Up (End of Month 9)**                                      │
│     - Based on feedback and analysis, decide if and how to expand        │
│  clean-up initiatives.                                                   │
│     - Plan additional events or establish a more formalized ongoing      │
│  clean-up schedule.                                                      │
│                                                                          │
│  **Milestones:**                                                         │

│  distribution.                                                           │
│  - Mid-month of Month 8: Feedback analysis complete.                     │
│  - End of Month 9: Expansion plans developed, possibly including         │
│  partnerships with schools or government bodies.                         │
│                                                                          │
│  **Skills Needed:**                                                      │
│  - Data analysis                                                         │
│  - Evaluation methods (quantitative and qualitative)                     │
│  - Strategic thinking                                                    │
│                                                                          │

│                                                                          │

│  clean-ups.                                                              │
│     - Establish a sustainable financial model, possibly through          │
│  donations or local business contributions.                              │
│                                                                          │

│     - Conduct regular progress meetings with volunteers and partners to  │
│  discuss achievements and challenges.                                    │
│     - Highlight successes in the community and recognize contributors    │
│  publicly.                                                               │
│                                                                          │
│  **Skills Needed:**                                                      │
│  - Fundraising                                                           │
│  - Community engagement                                                  │
│  - Public relations                                                      │
